findings.claim: The triage note's blanket assertion that Store-node counting means 'every binding form Python has is covered' is false — `except X as norm`, `import x as norm`, `def norm`, `global/nonlocal norm`, and match-statement capture patterns all rebind the name with zero Name(ctx=Store) nodes, and a match capture reproduces the R1 defect with the whole gate green.
findings.evidence: evals/adversarial/ui-offset-reproduction-contract.json triage note against src/repo_hygiene/eval_adapter.py:1704-1711, which counts only ast.Name with ctx=Store. Inserting a `match hit: case (_ct, norm, _n): pass` after src/sec10k/web/app.py:293 leaves _binds(...) == 1 (MatchAs.name is a bare str, not a Name node) while norm is rebound to hit[1], the raw filing. Reproduced: passed=True, 0 failures.
findings.repro: Apply the three-line match/case insertion after src/sec10k/web/app.py:293 and run run_case on the case -> passed=True, 0 failures.
findings.acceptance: The triage note drops the unqualified 'every binding form Python has is covered' and carries the same enumerated list the code comment (eval_adapter.py:1698-1699) and pr54-r2-resolution.json already use — assignment, augmented, walrus, tuple unpack, for-target — or _binds also counts ExceptHandler.name / alias.asname / MatchAs.name. Chasing the residual further is not asked for: `hit = (hit[0], hit[1], hit[1])` before the pinned binding is also green with the raw filing served, and no norm-binding guard can ever close it — the inherent ceiling of allow-list pinning, not a defect of the ast choice.

findings.claim: _binds matches only ast.FunctionDef, so converting the FastAPI handler to `async def` — a routine refactor, not a rename — makes the case RED with a message that misdiagnoses the cause as 'the function is gone or renamed'.
findings.evidence: src/repo_hygiene/eval_adapter.py:1708 `isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef)` never matches ast.AsyncFunctionDef. Fail-loud, so no wrong output — but it is the same red-for-the-wrong-reason class the round-1 note recorded for the decorator-keyed window.
findings.repro: sed `def api_normalized(` -> `async def api_normalized(` in src/sec10k/web/app.py, run run_case -> 1 failure blaming a rename.
findings.acceptance: isinstance(node, (ast.FunctionDef, ast.AsyncFunctionDef)), or the message stops asserting a cause it cannot distinguish.
